افتعلوا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَعَلُوا (iftaʕalū) /if.ta.ʕa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اُفْتُعِلُوا (uftuʕilū) /uf.tu.ʕi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اِفْتَعِلُوا (iftaʕilū) /if.ta.ʕi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
